source: Curated KJV (1611/1769) archaic-usage glossary, compiled for Gateway.
note: Each entry states what the word meant in 1611 English versus what a modern reader is likely to assume. This is the second clock: the original-language sense is a separate question, answered by the Strong's lexicon.

conversation.then: conduct, manner of life, how one behaves

corn.then: grain of any kind (usually wheat or barley)

let.then: to hinder or restrain (in some passages)

comprehend.then: to overcome, seize, take hold of (John 1:5)

peculiar.then: belonging especially to someone, one's own treasured possession

communicate.then: to share, to give a share of goods

study.then: to be diligent, to make effort (2 Tim 2:15)

fetch a compass.then: to travel in a circuit, go around

vile.then: of low estate, humble, lightly esteemed

bowels.then: the seat of deep emotion; compassion, tender affection

reins.then: the kidneys, understood as the seat of inner thought and conscience

heart.then: the center of thought, will, and intention — not merely feeling

soul.then: the whole living person (Hebrew nephesh), not only an immaterial part
soul.now_misread_as: a disembodied spirit inside the body

spirit.then: breath, wind, or animating life, depending on context

flesh.then: human nature in weakness, or the body, or kinship — context decides

world.then: the ordered age or system, or the inhabited earth — context decides

hell.then: renders several distinct words (Sheol, Hades, Gehenna, Tartarus) with different senses
hell.now_misread_as: one single place of eternal fire

damnation.then: judgment or condemnation generally, not always eternal

grace.then: favor freely shown, often with the sense of gift
grace.now_misread_as: elegance or a prayer before meals

fear.then: reverent awe when directed toward God, not merely terror

tempt.then: to test or try (God tests; He does not entice to evil)

hate.then: in some idioms, to love less by comparison (Luke 14:26)

know.then: in some contexts, intimate relational or sexual knowledge

allege.then: to prove, to cite as evidence

amazed.then: confounded, thrown into confusion or terror

coast.then: border, region (not necessarily by the sea)

generation.then: a race, kind, or class of people, as well as an age-group
generation.now_misread_as: people born in the same era only

ghost.then: spirit or breath ('gave up the ghost' = died)

occupy.then: to trade, to do business with (Luke 19:13)

purchase.then: to acquire or obtain (not necessarily by money)

room.then: a place or position (as in 'the highest rooms' = seats of honor)

trump.now_misread_as: a playing card or a surname

usury.then: interest on a loan of any amount

wonderful.then: causing wonder or astonishment, sometimes fearful
